During RSI Discovery Month, every pilot who completes the in-game 'RSI Discovery Month: Rental Offer' contract receives five days of free rental access to the RSI Constellation Mk V Centaurus and the Skylark.

RSI Discovery Month is an in-game Star Citizen event that began with Alpha 4.10.2 on October 9, 2026, in which all pilots across Stanton can run RSI-themed contracts (defence, supply runs, salvage and lost-cargo collection) to earn rewards across four mobiGlas reward tracks — ship paints, flight blades, components, armor and weapons.

Star Citizen is available only for Windows PC through the RSI Launcher, purchased directly from robertsspaceindustries.com — it is not sold on Steam, Epic, or GOG, and does not run on PlayStation, Xbox, or Game Pass (as of October 2026). Squadron 42, CIG's separate single-player game, does have a Steam page (wishlist only).

Squadron 42 has an official Steam store page (app 4045720, published by Roberts Space Industries, developed by Cloud Imperium Games) that went live on October 10, 2026; it can be wishlisted but not bought, lists a planned release of Q2 2027, Windows only, and notes support for linking a Roberts Space Industries account to a Steam account.
The cheapest Star Citizen game package, the Citizen Starter Pack (RSI Aurora Mk II), lists at $60 USD and was on sale for $45 (25% off) as of September 2026; no subscription is required to play.
